name: Ares Management
description: Ares is an alternative investment manager with $622.5 billion of assets under management, of which credit is about two-thirds ($406.9 billion). It earns management fees on the money clients commit or invest (3.68 billion in 2025), carried interest and incentive fees when funds perform, and administrative and transaction fees. Its largest strategies are direct lending (U.S. and European), liquid credit and alternative credit, followed by real estate and infrastructure, secondaries and private equity. Fee-related earnings, the steady core, were $1.78 billion in 2025.

businessLines.name: Credit Group
businessLines.how: Management fees on direct lending, liquid credit (CLOs and loans), alternative and opportunistic credit funds, plus incentive fees on perpetual vehicles and publicly traded funds; mostly long-dated or perpetual capital, billed quarterly on invested capital.

businessLines.name: Real Assets Group
businessLines.how: Management fees on real estate and infrastructure funds and perpetual wealth vehicles, plus carried interest on drawdown funds.

businessLines.name: Secondaries Group
businessLines.how: Fees on private equity, real estate, infrastructure and credit secondaries funds, plus carried interest on the drawdown funds.

businessLines.name: Private Equity Group
businessLines.how: Management fees on corporate and Asia-Pacific private equity funds plus carried interest on exits.

businessLines.name: Other and Operations Management Group
businessLines.how: Shared-cost centre and small other businesses; the Operations Management Group carries the platform's overhead, which is deducted to reach total Fee Related Earnings.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), Fee Related Earnings (Other 27.4 less Operations Management Group costs 808.2)
